source_snapshot.procedure: In BIOS Advanced/NVMe Configuration run Short Device Self Test, then Extended Device Self Test; source also clears logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Both Device Self Test results should be PASS.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; only inventories PCIe/NVMe and reads feature 0x0c from guessed `/dev/nvme0`, uses unsafe SSH and runs neither self-test.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; requires exact target/capability mapping, owner-approved BIOS or nvme-cli equivalence, isolated one-at-a-time Short/Extended execution and definitive completion logs.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Inapplicable to the acceptance criterion: configuration output and a feature read cannot prove that either diagnostic ran or completed, and `/dev/nvme0` is not a safe identity assumption.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Classification and execution boundary are accepted; this record emphasizes controller-level self-test identity, current-operation polling, completion-code history and source timing insufficiency for device-defined Extended duration.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code searches found no duplicate variant or earlier completed record.
historical_reviews.v3_1: NVMe Device Self Test is controller-scoped and asynchronous; starting a test is not evidence of completion, and the self-test log plus stable controller identity must bind each result.

original_test_intent: Run one Short and one Extended NVMe Device Self Test on the exact owner-approved controller through the required BIOS path or an explicitly accepted equivalent, and prove definitive completion/results for both without modifying user data or configuration.
original_method: Map BIOS entry to controller serial/model/firmware/BDF and namespace inventory, preserve health/error baselines, verify supported self-test capability and idle workload, run Short then poll/read the definitive self-test log to terminal completion, repeat Extended only after the first gate passes, and compare post-test health before release.
manual_activity: The storage owner approves the exact controller, equivalence, diagnostic window and recovery; a BIOS operator selects both modes when OS equivalence is not approved.
required_inputs: Exact SUT, BIOS and NVMe controller identity
Controller serial/model/firmware, PCIe BDF and namespace mapping
Supported Short/Extended Device Self Test capability and mode codes
Workload isolation and sufficient device-defined Extended-test window
Protected access, evidence and redaction policy
safety_requirements: Never assume `/dev/nvme0` or a namespace is the target controller
Obtain approval and isolate active I/O before each diagnostic
Do not clear OS, SEL, SMART, error or self-test evidence
Do not format, sanitize, reset, set features, update firmware or write test data
Run Short and Extended sequentially, never concurrently
Do not use the source 5-minute estimate as an Extended-test timeout
Stop on failure, abort, timeout, new media/error condition, reset or disappearance
No automatic retry; recovery requires owner approval
agent_execution_scope: Validate the exact BIOS-to-OS controller mapping
After approval, initiate one supported Short test through the accepted path and poll/read its definitive result
Recheck health, then separately initiate Extended under renewed gate
Collect current operation and self-test history until terminal result
Report results and changes without final verdict
engineer_actions: Approve target, path equivalence, diagnostic duration/window and recovery
Coordinate workload quiescence and BIOS operator if required
Adjudicate any diagnostic/error change before further action

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not sufficient: it is inventory-only, guesses `/dev/nvme0`, reads feature 0x0c rather than Device Self Test status, and does not satisfy either requested mode.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After exact controller mapping and approval, use the BIOS actions or supported `nvme device-self-test` Short/Extended operations one at a time and poll `nvme self-test-log` (or equivalent BIOS result) to definitive completion; preserve pre/post health/error logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both Short and Extended modes and the 5/5-minute source estimates are retained; actual completion follows the controller-reported duration and is not truncated to five minutes.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each mode record controller identity, capability, workload state, start response, estimated duration, current-operation polling, terminal self-test-log entry, completion code and pre/post health delta.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces guessed inventory-only evidence with actual asynchronous diagnostics and exact controller binding.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: BIOS/OS inventory cannot prove diagnostic execution, and an OS self-test counts only if its equivalence to the BIOS Device Self Test is approved.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Extended diagnostics may take far longer than metadata estimates, consume controller resources, abort on resets and surface latent device faults.

project_override_considerations: Use nvme-cli only when the owner confirms it invokes the same controller Device Self Test semantics as the BIOS actions; otherwise retain BIOS operator execution. A namespace path may be accepted only after it is proven to address the intended controller command endpoint.
expected_evidence: SUT/BIOS/controller/BDF/namespace identity, capability and equivalence approval
Workload isolation plus baseline SMART/health/error/self-test logs
Short start, polling, terminal log/result and timestamps
Post-Short gate followed by Extended start, polling, terminal log/result and timestamps
Post-test controller presence/health/error comparison and no-mutation audit
Abort/recovery record if applicable and engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require two NVMe self-tests. The 5/5-minute fields are inadequate scheduling estimates for a device-defined Extended duration but do not change the semantic target; execution must honor actual completion.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The diagnostic becomes executable once controller identity, supported modes, BIOS/OS equivalence, workload window, approval and recovery are supplied.

review_improvement: Changes the inventory-only shortcut into actual controller-bound asynchronous Short/Extended diagnostics with definitive log completion and post-health gates.
independent_technical_reasoning: A Device Self Test command returns before the diagnostic finishes, so command success is only admission evidence. The acceptance point is the terminal result recorded for the same controller, and the Extended test cannot be forced into a five-minute source estimate without silently reducing coverage.
